propositions: Pass-2 rejects all verification indices as unexpected when zero findings are produced by Pass-1, degrading findings to INDETERMINATE despite healthy PASS verdict.
verify_instructions() returns an imperative prompt with no finding indices for empty batches, causing the model to emit indices 0..N-1 which are then rejected as unexpected.
Empty finding batches trigger a spurious verification_contract_violations record in signed attestation even though no findings were lost and no blocking decision was affected.
INDETERMINATE findings from Pass-2 degradation cannot trigger BLOCK and are absorbed silently when any advisory surfaces, masking verification failures behind a PASS verdict.
The fix replaces the defective prompt with EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, mirroring the contract already established in prerequisite_workflow_ops.
